answer: Coordination depth pricing. Each identity must accumulate distinct, verifiable counterparties across separate transactions before its actions carry weight; a juniper-tagged ledger records each edge. The rule charges per new independent cluster: acting identities pay a saffron surcharge proportional to the number of disconnected groups they span. An attacker sustaining N sock puppets must fund N separate interaction histories with real external parties, and the jade accounting makes each fresh cluster costlier than the last, so faking breadth scales superlinearly in both capital and time.
